name: ill_conditioned_3x3
description: Mildly ill-conditioned 3x3 SDP: max x_11+epsilon*x_22 s.t. x_11=1, x_22=1, 2*x_12=0, X 3x3 PSD, where epsilon=1e-6. The small coefficient epsilon=1/1000000 creates mild ill-conditioning in the Schur complement. Optimal value = 1+1/1000000 = 1000001/1000000 (exact rational).
reference_method: Exact closed form: opt = 1 + 10^(-6) = 1000001/1000000 (exact rational arithmetic in Mathematica).

known_gaps.reason: adaptive returns ADAPTIVE_OPTIMAL at final_prec=128 (no escalation) but the recovered objective midpoint is only ~8.9 digits vs target 12: the 6-flag inner tolerance (1e-12) passes on scaled residuals while the point-mode objective recovery at 128 bits is conditioning-limited (epsilon=1e-6 nearly-flat objective). p68 (controller must validate objective accuracy / set prec floor from target_digits); root cause shared with b30.

at the natural escalation ceiling (target_digits=30 forces escalation to 1024 bits for 14.1 objective digits) the cost is ~73 bits/digit, far above the 8 b/d goal; epsilon=1e-6 ill-conditions the Schur complement (NUM at 128/256/512 until 1024).
